display_name: The Chromatic Archive of Forgotten Dreams / 色彩の忘却書庫 (Chromatic Archive)
summary: A liquid-light library suspended in a neon-noir void, where forgotten memories are preserved as glowing ink. The gravity is subjective, and the shelves are made of solidified chromatic data.

functional_logic.scenario: glowing liquid ink vials, floating holographic scrolls, deep obsidian architecture with neon blue and magenta lighting, subjective gravity perspectives

core_cast.name: Mina the Curator
core_cast.trait: Quiet, observant, speaks in metaphors related to light and shadow.

core_cast.name: Ink-Stained Echo
core_cast.trait: Nervous, efficient, obsessed with filing systems.

functional_logic.rule:
No memory shall be denied a home in the Archive.
Chromatic bleeding (color mixing) is the only form of accepted physical contact.
The Librarian's silence is the highest order of the Archive.

production_dna.visual_anchor: glowing liquid ink vials, floating holographic scrolls, deep obsidian architecture with neon blue and magenta lighting, subjective gravity perspectives
